decisions.reason: Because the firm has publicly presented Product A as a flagship/focus and has invested in a multi-model product line close to its established offer, escalation of commitment makes management likely to persist rather than write off the investment and admit the launch was a mistake.

Because Product B is a recently launched flagship/focus with a dedicated public launch and builds on the firm's established offer, management is committed and likely to keep it, as dropping it would write off the investment and expose the earlier decision as a mistake.
